{{Top}}
[[File:Blasterpack.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] blaster power pack]]
'''Blaster power packs''', also known as '''blaster cartridges''' or '''blaster ammo packs''', were small [[Power cell/Legends|energy-storage devices]] that powered portable [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].

These power packs carried both a small electrical storage unit (such as a battery or other such device) and a quantity of compressed spin-sealed [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas. Power packs for rifles (such as the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11]]) typically carried enough tibanna and electricity for one hundred shots. Alternatively, plasma packs of the same size could power a blaster for up to five hundred shots, although with a slight decrease in the accuracy and cooling power of the weapon.
